goal: Simulate an independent cross-subsystem trust-boundary review without remediation or external mutation.
success_criteria: The packet stops before secret inspection, remediation, or trust-boundary expansion.
primary_hypothesis: A read-only reviewer can assess a cross-subsystem boundary from the security contract and exact enforcement points.
discriminating_check: Verify that the selected role is read-only and the packet contains no mutation-capable deliverable.
stop_conditions: A secret or sensitive full file is required.
